meta.promptText: India mein men ke liye konse brand ki formal shirts kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
India mein men ke liye formal shirts ke liye kai behtareen brands available hain, jo alag-alag budget aur quality preferences ke hisaab se aate hain. Aapki zaroorat ke mutabiq best brands ki list neeche di gayi hai:

---

### 1. Premium & Luxury Brands (Corporate & Office Wear ke liye)

Agar aap professional look, premium fabric aur long-lasting durability chahte hain:

* **Van Heusen:** Corporate professionals ke liye sabse popular brands mein se ek. Inki fit, comfort, aur wrinkle-resistant shirts office wear ke liye ekdum perfect hain.
* **Louis Philippe:** Ek premium brand jo apni superior quality, elegant designs aur classy formal look ke liye jana jata hai.
* **Allen Solly:** Agar aap thoda modern, stylish aur smart-formal look chahte hain, toh Allen Solly best hai. Yeh vibrant colors aur contemporary fits provide karte hain.

---

### 2. Mid-Range & Value-for-Money Brands (Best Quality on Budget)

Agar aapko reasonable price mein achhi quality chahiye:

* **Peter England:** India ke sabse trusted aur pocket-friendly formal brands mein se ek hai. College graduates aur fresh professionals ke liye yeh ek great choice hai.
* **Arrow:** Heritage brand jo apni classic tailoring aur crisp formal shirts ke liye famous hai. Inki quality aur durability bahut achhi hoti hai.
* **Park Avenue:** Raymond group ka yeh brand formal wear, especially trouser aur shirt combinations ke liye kafi popular hai.

---

### 3. Everyday Office Wear & Comfort Brands

* **Raymond:** Pure cotton aur classic fabrics ke liye Raymond par bharosa kiya ja sakta hai. Aap chahe toh inke store se kapda lekar custom stitching bhi karwa sakte hain.
* **blackberrys:** Modern cuts aur sharp tailoring ke sath yeh brand corporate meetings aur events ke liye ideal shirts offer karta hai.

---

### 💡 Buying Tips:

* **Fabric:** Garmi ke mausam mein **100% Cotton** ya **Cotton-Linen** blends sabse comfortable rehte hain.
* **Fit:** Apni body type ke mutabiq **Slim Fit** ya **Tailored Fit** chunein taaki ek sharp professional look mile.

Aapka budget lagbhag kitna hai aur aap kis tarah ke occasion (daily office wear ya kisi special meeting/interview) ke liye shirt kharidna chahte hain?
